title: Asymptotically attaining the Moore bound
summary: For positive integers $d$ and $k$, let $n_k(d)$ be the maximum order of a graph of maximum degree at most $d$ and diameter at most $k$. We prove that $$ \lim_{d\to\infty}\frac{n_k(d)}{d^k}=1$$ for every fixed $k$, thereby resolving the asymptotic degree-diameter problem for fixed diameter and proving a conjecture of Bollobás. The lower bound comes from regular graphs $H_{k,q}$, indexed by prime powers $q$, whose vertices are partial flags in $\mathbb{F}_q^{\,2k+1}$.
